question: When can't Artemis II astronauts add water to food, and what do they eat?
answer: Most Artemis II food is freeze-dried, so water must be added to it. During launch and re-entry the water dispenser is not available, so for those hours the crew eats only ready-to-eat food, like tortillas.
move: Launch and re-entry: no water, so only ready-to-eat food like tortillas.
